# Security Policy

Please report suspected security vulnerabilities privately instead of opening a public issue.

Use the repository's GitHub private vulnerability reporting feature under **Security > Advisories**, if it is enabled. Otherwise, contact a maintainer through the [Elkan 5e Discord](https://discord.gg/UYq2UwGz95) and request a private channel.

Please include:

- A description of the issue and affected files or features.
- Reproduction steps or a proof of concept.
- The Elkan 5e, Foundry VTT, and dnd5e versions involved.
- Whether you have already disclosed the issue elsewhere.

Please allow maintainers to investigate and coordinate a fix before public disclosure.
